agent_control.standards_role: Leeway Standards controls all decisions, permission gates, claims, and update rules.
agent_control.agent_role: Executive operator, planner, update coordinator, and receipt writer.

update_modes.hot_patch: Patch a live lane and restart only that container.
update_modes.distribution_update: Create customer update pack with manifest, installer, validation, and rollback.
update_modes.rolling_lane_update: Update one container at a time with health checks between.
update_modes.staged_update: Apply patch to staging copy, validate, then promote.
update_modes.model_swap: Switch model provider or image tag through config and restart only affected model lane.
update_modes.standards_update: Update governance policy and force all agents to reload standards.

next_build_phases: Phase U1: Full system evidence audit across every container, file, image, port, endpoint, and placeholder.
Phase U2: Update planner and patch receipt runtime.
Phase U3: Per-lane hot restart and rollback scripts.
Phase U4: Model hot-swap config and validation gates.
Phase U5: Customer update pack builder.
Phase U6: Phone/Desktop/Email/Calendar/Browser true wiring with proof.

mandatory_truth_layers.architecture_truth: containers, images, roles, ports, mounts, lane truth, running state
mandatory_truth_layers.customer_truth: installed packs, enabled modules, configured providers, local machine constraints
mandatory_truth_layers.evidence_truth: proof receipts, validation outputs, behavior checks
mandatory_truth_layers.runtime_truth: health endpoints, status endpoints, logs, active ports, container state
mandatory_truth_layers.capability_truth: what each lane can actually do today
mandatory_truth_layers.code_truth: source files, hashes, compile checks, tests, placeholder scans

purpose: Provide safe continuous updates from laser-focused patches to full system upgrades without destroying or blindly restarting the whole ecosystem.
